title: Object Lock
shortDescription: Setting an indefinite (legal hold) or temporary (retention) lock on object deletion, as well as configuring the default retention lock
metaDescription: All available methods for working with object locking in VK Object Storage: set or remove an indefinite lock (PutObjectLegalHold), get the status of an indefinite lock (GetObjectLegalHold), set, configure, or remove a temporary lock (PutObjectRetention), get the status of a temporary lock (GetObjectRetention), set, configure, or remove the default temporary lock (PutObjectLockConfiguration), or get the status of the default temporary lock (GetObjectLockConfiguration)
